operations.name: stripe_list_products
operations.description: List existing Stripe products, to check what is already set up before creating another. Read-only.

operations.name: stripe_balance
operations.description: Current Stripe balance, available and pending. The measured answer to 'has this actually earned anything', as opposed to an estimate. Read-only.

operations.name: stripe_list_charges
operations.description: List recent Stripe charges, so an outcome can report real revenue rather than a guess. Read-only.

operations.name: stripe_create_product
operations.description: Create a Stripe product -- the thing being sold. Pair with stripe_create_price and stripe_create_payment_link to get a working checkout. Only usable when a proposal listing this tool has been approved.

operations.name: stripe_create_price
operations.description: Create a price for an existing Stripe product. Amounts are in the currency's smallest unit (2900 = $29.00). Only usable when a proposal listing this tool has been approved.

unitAmount.describe: Amount in the smallest currency unit -- cents for usd, so 2900 means $29.00

recurringInterval.describe: Omit for a one-off price; set it for a subscription

operations.name: stripe_create_payment_link
operations.description: Create a hosted Stripe checkout link for a price -- a URL a customer can pay at immediately, with no site or server needed. Returns the link as `url`. Only usable when a proposal listing this tool has been approved.
